notes: Single self-contained HTML file, everything drawn procedurally on canvas (no image assets). Main menu, how-to-play, leaderboard (top-10 in localStorage), pause, mute, shovel, 5 plant types (sunflower, peashooter, snow pea, wall-nut, cherry bomb), 3 zombie types (basic, cone, bucket), 38-zombie wave schedule with final-wave banner, win/lose flow with score. WebAudio synth for SFX and no external dependencies. Headless-browser verified end-to-end: plant placement, shovel, sun collection, zombie spawn/walk timing, house-breach lose flow at ~81s with no defenses, and leaderboard save (TestBot/100 round-tripped through localStorage).
